purpose: Isolated S32 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Established status gates applicability; trial-adequacy and observation-window context use window attribution with no invented thresholds.

fields.definition: Schizophrenia status represented by the scenario; registration diagnosis review establishes Yes/No for this encounter.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88; diagnosis v1 supplies structured diagnosis, this field is the reviewed encounter synthesis
fields.operationalization: Yes requires a documented current schizophrenia diagnosis review at this encounter; No requires a documented assessment finding schizophrenia not established (first-time case). Unknown assessment pauses. Copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Persistent significant symptoms represented in the scenario, with symptom-domain note where recorded.
fields.operationalization: Yes requires clinician-recorded persistent significant symptoms despite pharmacological treatment; No requires assessment finding no such persistence. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: First prior antipsychotic trial categorized by exposure adequacy, response or intolerance; agents and changes only, no regimen details.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (treatment adequacy review)
fields.operationalization: Assessment cites the prior trial agent and window with exposure/response/intolerance category. Duration, dose and adherence thresholds require owner review; none are set here. Missing assessment pauses and is never coerced to an adequate-trial finding. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Second prior antipsychotic trial categorized by exposure adequacy, response or intolerance; agents and changes only, no regimen details.

fields.operationalization: Assessment cites the prior trial agent and window with exposure/response/intolerance category. Duration, dose and adherence thresholds require owner review; none are set here. Missing assessment pauses and is never coerced to an adequate-trial finding. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether the two prior trials used different antipsychotic agents.
fields.operationalization: Yes requires two documented distinct trial agents; No requires documented same-agent trials. Unknown pauses. Agent identities only; no regimen details. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether significant symptoms lasted at least the reviewed observation window, recorded without inventing a new threshold.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (research observation window)
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed observation-window finding with window attribution. The concrete window operationalization requires owner review. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether at least moderate symptoms and functional impairment were recorded, without inventing scale cutoffs.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (validated rating scales and functioning)
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed severity/impairment finding with scale and window attribution. Concrete cutoffs require owner review; none are set here. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Never, current or previous clozapine treatment represented in the scenario.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Initiation of Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 89-90
fields.operationalization: NeverTreated requires explicit assessment of no prior or current clozapine; CurrentTreatment/PreviouslyTreated require documented status with encounter/window. Unknown history pauses. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Willingness to discuss clozapine; shared decision-making review input used only as defined and collected.

fields.operationalization: Yes means patient is willing to discuss clozapine after shared discussion; No means unwillingness or unresolved concerns documented. Missing discussion remains unknown, not No. Operational meaning requires owner review. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Appropriateness of a clozapine initiation discussion represented as a scenario assumption for review.

fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed appropriateness finding with encounter attribution. Operational meaning requires owner review. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-determined urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs at this encounter; displayed independently of estimation latency.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Monitoring for Side Effects During Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 90-93; Balancing of Potential Benefits and Harms in Rating the Strength of the Guideline Statement / Harms
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs during current assessment; Absent means urgent assessment was completed without identified concern. This banner renders from saved inputs independently of estimation latency and is never a model-computed risk percentage. Unknown assessment pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Concern about adherence, smoking or caffeine changes, interactions, concentrations or sample timing.
